description.p: Rookparcel is a lean BitTorrent client in the spirit of µTorrent 2.2.1: small, fast, native and comfortable with thousands of torrents. Its engine is a Rust port of libtorrent-rasterbar.

ul.li: Downloads and seeds over TCP and uTP, with HTTP, HTTPS and UDP trackers
Magnet links, DHT, peer exchange and local peer discovery
Encryption, web seeds, proxies, UPnP and NAT-PMP, IP filters
A tray icon, desktop notifications and Auto Shutdown

description.p: Rookparcel is pre-alpha: settings and saved state may change between versions. It is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, so it is free for noncommercial use only.

PaTorrent is now Rookparcel, with a new icon, the Postal Rook. Settings, torrents, profiles and portable folders from PaTorrent are taken over at the first start. A Web UI login refused after a ban is now answered as banned.

Profiles run several independent Rookparcels side by side, and portable mode keeps one in a folder that can move between drives and systems. A Setup Guide at the first start, help for every setting, a filter in the Files tab, binding torrent traffic to a VPN, and an optional search helper that fetches Jackett for you are new. A bug hunt fixed 37 problems, among them a Web UI login bypass and a peer message that crashed the engine.

A gamer mode keeps your ping low by slowing transfers down when your line starts to queue. Smart disk I/O checks torrents gently, one per drive, tells SSDs, hard disks and network shares apart, and can slow down while a disk is busy. A window shows what Rookparcel is doing while it closes, the Files tab has µTorrent 2.2.1's menu, completed downloads can move into a folder named after their label, and the engine carries the applicable fixes from libtorrent 2.0.12 to 2.1.2.

Torrent search through your own Prowlarr or Jackett, the RSS Downloader in the Windows client's Web UI, an optional API key and subnet whitelist for Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr, and an update check in the headless daemon.

Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr work with Rookparcel as their download client: seed limits arrive with each grab and Remove Completed removes finished torrents. Idle seeds keep counting their seeding time, adding a torrent brings the window forward, and a torrent added stopped reads Stopped.

The Windows GUI serves its own Web UI from Preferences, so a browser shows and drives that window's torrents. The daemon's Windows service command stores the Web UI login hashed and can replace and start an installed service in one step.

A search box that filters the torrent list by name, importing torrents from qBittorrent and µTorrent, security hardening across the engine, the Web UI and the remote mode, and icons beside the category list, the detail tabs and the Preferences pages.
First stable release. The window title and the tray tooltip show the version.
First pre-alpha build of the GTK GUI as a Flatpak.
